card.name: Word-initial S before a vowel
card.fires_on: The letter S (or 's') that begins a new word or word part, mostly right after a hyphen, space or sentence start, and followed by a vowel such as o, a, u or e. It also fires inside words like immunosuppressant.

modes.label: Standalone S starting a word
modes.description: A lone S or s is split off at the start of a word like sardonic, sophisticated, sizzling or Suspend.

modes.label: S after a hyphen or inside a compound
modes.description: S begins the second part of a hyphenated or compound term such as anti-sodomy or potassium-sparing.

modes.label: Inside immunosuppressant-type words
modes.description: The split falls just before the s of suppress in immuno- words.

card.plain: It marks the spot where a word starts with the letter S, often when the word is broken into pieces.
